tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// gzhan phan nyer mkho bzhugs// ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das dpal ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// thog mar bdag gi rnal 'byor bstan pa ni/ rgyud las/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug nas// thams cad zos te kun byas kyang*// 'grub 'gyur nyes pas mi gos na// snying rje ldan pa smos ci dgos// zhes 'byung bas/ dkyil 'khor kun tu 'jug pa rdo rje sems dpa'i skyed chog brjod par bya'o// de brjod pa ni/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyis// bdag bsrung la sogs byas nas kyang*// bdag gi de nyid dran byed cing*// zhes 'byung bas na/ thog mar bsrung ba bya ste/ de'ang thog mar chos thams cad bdag med pa dang*/ de ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje chen po dang*/ de dag thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod par bya'o// snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom/ de nas de'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ bsam/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus pa las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon dril bu/ dkur 'dzin par bsams la/ de'i snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ bsams la/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus pa las/ bdag nyid 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba/ dbu mtha' yas pa/ phyag mtha' yas pa/ sbrul dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mtshon cha sna tshogs dang*/ rgyu ma dang mgo thod shas gang ba phyag na bsnams par bsams la/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur byas la/ mthe'u chung lu gu rgyud du sbrel la mdzub mo gnyis sdigs mdzub tu byas la/ oṃbadz+ra satwa kro dha a na lārka ma hā badz+ra kro dha/ dra ba dra ba/ bi dra ba bi dra ba/ sarba ā pa ya/ nā sha ya/ nā sha ya/ ha ra ha ra prā ṇā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis bdag bsrung*/ lan gsum gyis gnas bsrung*/

lan gsum gyis rnal 'byor bsrungs la/ rgyas par byed na khro bo'i bstod pa yang bya'o// de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas stong par bsams la/ de'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsams la/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ rang rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan gdangs pa dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar bstod de 'dzin pa g.yon dril bu kha dkur bstan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par bsams la/ de nas 'khor los sgyur ba nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ lag pa gnyis mdun du bzhag la/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re bsams la/ hūm̐ zhes bya ba dang a zhes bya bas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de gnyis byin gyis brlabs la/ lag pa gnyis ka'i thal mo gnyis la a la sogs pa dbyangs kyi yi ge bcu drug gis gang zhing 'od zer spro bar bya ste/ mthe bong gnyis la oṃ zhes bya ba dang*/ mdzub mo gnyis la hūm̐/ gung mo gnyis la trām̐/ srin lag gnyis la hrīḥ mthe'u chung gnyis la aḥbazhag la/ de ltar yi ge rnams bzhag par byas la/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yin par mos pa bskyed pa dang*/ chos thams cad gcig la gcig 'dres pa dang*/ bdag dang rjes su mthun par byas te/ zhes gsungs pas/ sa bon las g.yas pa'i mthe bong la rnam par snang mdzad/ mdzub mo la mi bskyod pa/ gung mo la rin chen 'byung ldan/ srin lag la 'od dpag med/ mthe'u chung la don yod grub pa/ g.yon gyi mthe bong la rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ mdzub mo la rdo rje thugs ma/ gung mo la rdo rje dbang bskur ma/ srin lag la rdo rje mtshon cha ma/ mthe'u chung la rdo rje kun ma rnams phan tshun lha dang*/

lha mo'i khyad par ma yin pa sku mdog phyag mtshan la sogs pa rigs lnga bzhin bsams la/ mnyam pa'i thal mo dang*/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmā/ zhes pas lha dang lha mo phan tshun reg par bsam mo// rdo rje thal mo dang*/ s+pha ra s+pha ra a nu pra wiṣ+ṭa sarba dharmā/ zhes pas rjes su zhugs par bsam/ rdo rje bsdams pa dang*/ a t+yan+ta a nu pra wiṣ+ṭa sarba dharmā badz+ra añdza li/ zhes pas gnyis su med par ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam mo// sems 'od gsal bar bsgoms la/ oṃ badz+ra ban+dha traṭa/ ces brjod cing*/ rdo rje bsdams pa lan gsum dral bas sdig pa dral bar bsam/ badz+ra ā be sha aḥzhes pa dang*/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i mthe bong nang du bcug pa bcings la/ a a zhes mang du zlos shing rang gi snying gar dang po'i rdo rje'i rnam pa char bzhin babs pas ye shes phab pa dang*/ de brten par bya ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ sha shwa to me bha wa/ hṛ da ya me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi me pra yats+tsha hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥzhes brjod la sngar gyi phyag rgya dral lo// yang badz+ra muṣ+ṭiḥzhes brjod do// rdo rje bsdams pa'i mthe bong nang du bcug pa'i mthe bong gi rgyab tu mdzub mos bkab pa nang du bcug la/ oṃ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi baṃ/ zhes brjod la bkrol te se gol gtogs la brtan par bya'o// de ltar ye shes phab cing brtan par byas pa'i rjes la/ phyag rgyas phyag rgya de byin rlabs// zhes pas byin gyis brlabs te/ shāka thub kyi skabs nas 'byung ba bzhin/ mnyam par gzhag pas dpral bar ni// phyag 'tshal ba yi thal mo sbyar// sangs rgyas bde gshegs skyes rnams kyis// phyag 'tshal ba yi phyag rgyar bshad// rnal 'byor rig pas mgrin phyogs su// thal mo snyim par sbyar ba ni// rtag tu pad+ma'i rigs nyid kyi// pad+ma'i phyag rgya yin par bshad// rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas kyang*// snying gar gung mo mtha' sbyar ba// rdo rje rigs kyi phyag rgya 'di// dam tshig thams cad 'dzin byed pa'o// phyag rgya dang po dpral bar bzhag la/

oṃ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sarba ā wa ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ phyag rgya gnyis pa mgrin par bzhag la/ oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarba ā wa ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ phyag rgya gsum pa snying gar bzhag ste/ oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba ā wa ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs la/ yang*/ lta 'og go rim ji bzhin du// sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ro// zhes pas sangs rgyas lnga'i dbang bskur bar bya ste/ phyag na rdo rje'i skabs nas 'byung ba/ rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo rdo rje 'dra bar gshibs pa las mthe bong dang mthe chung brkyang ba ni phyag na rdo rje yi'o// de nyid las mthe bong dang mthe'u chung de bzhin du byas la/ mdzub mo dang srin lag pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa sbyong ba'i rgyal po yi'o// de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis rin po che 'dra bar byas pa ni dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya'o// mthe bong dang mthe'u chung so sor bsdams la lhag ma thams cad brkyang ba ni sdig pa thams cad sreg pa'i phyag rgya'o// lag pa g.yon par de bzhin du bsgyur ba ni las thams cad pa'i phyag rgya'o// zhes 'byung ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya dang po spyi bor bzhag la spyi bor mi bskyod pa bsam mo// sngags dang phyag rgya gnyis pa dpral bar reg pas dpral bar rnam par snang mdzad/ sngags dang phyag rgya gsum pa rna ba g.yas pa'i steng du rin 'byung*/ sngags dang phyag rgya bzhi pa gnyis kyis ltag par 'od dpag med/ sngags dang phyag rgya lnga pa gnyis kyis rna ba g.yon par don yod grub pa bsam mo// rang gi rigs rnam par snang mdzad yin na spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad bskyed do// de ltar rdo rje sems dpar bdag nyid bskyed nas gleng gzhi nas 'byung ba bzhin bsam ste/ tshangs pa chen po pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs te/ de nas ngan song gi rgyud yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ ngan song gsum gyi rgyud las rnam par grol ba zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'od zer spro ba dang*/

sdud pa mang po'i phreng ba nyid kyi dpral ba'i mdzod spu nas phyung nas/ des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag thams cad kun tu snang bar byas so// kun tu snang bar byas pas sems can thams cad kyi sems nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las rnam par grol te bde ba so sor thob nas/ yang dga' ba'i tshal thams cad kun tu snang bar byas so// mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs kyis mchod de/ lan brgya stong du bskor ba byas nas/ lan brgya stong du mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar nor bu dri ma med pa'i steng du 'khod de/ 'di skad ces gsol to// e ma'o sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas// e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs// gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyongs// byang chub spyod ba nyid la bzhag /ces brjod par bsam mo// 'gro ba de rnams kyis bdag la mchod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas// zhes bya ba la sogs pas bstod par bsam mo// de nas ched du gtad pa'i bzlas pa ni/ bdag gi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du rtsa rig bkod la/ de las 'od 'phros pas rgyu dang 'bras bu'i ngan song thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rnams zhi bar mdzad nas khams gsum thams cad snang bar byas te/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du don byas nas/ yang rang gi snying ga'i chos kyi yi ge de nyid la zhugs par bsam zhing*/ yang sngar bzhin bsam zhing*/ rtsa ba'i rig pa bzlas par bya'o// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri shodha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi shodha ni shud+dhe bi shud+dhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes bzlas par bya'o// de nas thun mtshams su yi ge brgya pas brtan par byas la/ bdag nyid la mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa byas te/ smon lam btab la/ gtor ma dang*/

bskor ba dang*/ sāts+tsha la sogs pa thun mtshams gyi bya ba rnams bya'o// bdag gi rnal 'byor dang bsnyen pa gnyis ka bstan zin to// //bdag gi rnal 'byor dang bsnyen pa gnyis ka sngon du song nas/ khro bo spyan drangs shing bstod pa bya ste/ hūm̐ ye shes bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// ces pa nas 'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// zhes pa'i bar gyis khro bo mang po spyan drangs la sngags dang phyag rgya tsam gyis mchod pa lnga dbul lo// de nas bstod pa bya ste/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las// zhes pa nas/ bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pa'i bar gyis bstod cing*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la sogs pa'i sngags kyis bskrad la/ de nas bdag bskyed la mchod bstod byas nas/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes pas bgegs bsang*/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā lā na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas gzi brjid bskyed la/ mchod yon la sogs pa rang rang gi sngags brjod la/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar bsams la/ dbul ba'i tshe ngag tu brjod pa rnams dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ dbyangs med kyang rung ste bdag gis brjod la/ yid kyi rigs drug ngan song las thar ba rnams kyis/ bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor gnas pa la mchod bstod byed par bsam zhing dbul te/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// zhes sogs nas/ sems can don kun mdzad du gsol// zhes pa'i bar brjod la// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ mchod yon gyi gnas su me tog dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ mar me dang*/ dri dang*/ zhal zas rnams bcug la/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ zhes bya ba rnams bcug la/

sngags dang phyag rgyas dbul bar bya'o// rol mo yang dbul bar bya'o// de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ dbyangs med kyang rung ste/ sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas// zhes pa nas/ thams cad rdo rje'i bdag nyid gtso// zhes pa'i bar gyis bdag nyid la bstod la/ de nas mdun bskyed la mchod pa ni/ ras bris dang lugs ma la sogs pa'i rten la/ ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ rdo rje dril bu dang spos 'dzin pa'i sngags pas dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ hūm̐ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan rnam snang 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// zhes pa tsam mam/ yang byed par 'dod na de'i steng du/ bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// zhes pa nas/ yang dag 'khor dang bcas nas gshegs su gsol// zhes pa'am spros pa la dga' na de'i steng du/ chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso// zhes pa nas/ mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ zhes bya ba dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bha ga wāṃ e h+ye hi mahā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya ho sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes bya bas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ de la thog mar mchod yon dbul te/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ye hūm̐/ de nas khrus gsol te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣa ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de nas gdan dbul te/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/

zhes pas gdan phul la/ sngags tsam gyis mchod de/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes pas rten rnams la bstim mo// de nas mchod pa bya ba ni/ ar+gha mchog brtags gsang la sogs pa yi// dbyangs snyan pa yis bstod dang lha rdzas kyi// mchog gi dam pa rnams kyis legs par mchod// ces gsungs pas/ dngos su 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang*/ gsang ba ste lha mo brgyad dang*/ sogs pa ste mchod pa nyi shu pa dang*/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la sogs pa dang*/ lha rdzas te yid las byung ba'i rin po che sna bdun la sogs pa'o// de la dngos su 'byor pa'i mchod pa rnams/ bsang ba la sogs pa byas la dbul ba ni/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// zhes pa nas/ sems can don kun mdzad du gsol// zhes pa'i bar brjod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod yon dbul/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su me tog dang*/ bdug pa/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas rnams bcug la/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ zhes pa dang rol mo la/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sel byed la// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsā li te/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā nā da saṃ bha we ta badz+ra dharma hṛ dā ya san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes pas rol mo'i bar du tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ sngags dang phyag rgyas dbul bar byas te/ de dag ni ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas dngos su 'byor pa'i mchod pa'o// de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa ni lha mo brgyad kyis mchod de/ dbyangs dang bcas pas/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pa na// rdo rje rin chen bla na med// rdo rje chos ni glur blangs pa// rdo rje las kun byed par 'gyur// zhes bya'o de skad sor bzhag pa ni/

oṃ badz+ra satwa su saṃ gra ha da/ badz+ra rat+na mu nut+ta raṃ/ badz+ra dharma ga ya ni/ badz+ra karmāḥka rod+bha we/ zhes bya ba dang*/ oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūm̐/ zhes bya ba las kyi phyag rgya bcing*/ rang sgeg mor bsams la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod par bya'o// de bzhin du lā s+ye'i gnas su// oṃ badz+ra mā le trām̐/ oṃ badz+ra gī ti hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra nṛ tre aḥ zhes pas nang gi bzhi dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trām̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe aḥ zhes pas phyi'i lha mo bzhi brjod cing*/ lus kyis gar sngon du 'gro bas las kyi phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ rdo rje bsgyings ma'i tshul gyis su// bsam pa g.yos pas 'dud par bya// phreng ba bcing dang kha nas dbyung*// gar las thal sbyar spyi bor bzhag /'og tu blugs dang gyen du 'thor// mthe bong gshibs te bsgreng ba nyid// dri yis byug pa'i tshul du ni// mchod pa'i phyag rgya rab tu brtag /ces de nyid 'dus pa nas gsungs so// gsang ba'i mchod pa'o// mchod pa nyi shu pa dang*/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la sogs pa dang*/ kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin la sogs pa ni 'dir ma spros so// rin chen sna bdun dbul bar 'dod na/ lag pa'i mkhrig ma bsnol te rgyab sbyar la/ sor mo rnams gcig la gcig 'khyud pa'i mthe bong gnyis lag pa'i mthil du bkug la 'khor lo ltar byas la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra rat+na pū dzi te hūm̐/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la sbyar/ mdzub mo gnyis bkug la mthe bong rtse sprad de tshigs bcag la/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkren cing phongs pa rgyun bcad nas// 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi rat+na pū dzi te hūm̐/

rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo bsgreng ba'i logs la mdzub mo gnyis gcig la gcig sbyar te bcer la/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas// ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wa ti rat+na pū dze te hūm̐/ rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo dang mtha' bzhi gshibs te bsgrengs la/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas// phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum bstan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin zhing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta mahā rat+na pū dzi te hūm̐/ lag pa g.yas pa glang po che'i sna ltar brkyangs te/ g.yon pas gru mo nas bzung la/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas// lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas// bla med theg pa rab zhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hasti rat+na pū dzi te hūm̐/ rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs kyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du phyin par bsams la/ khu tshur bcangs pa bcer ba'i gung mo gnyis dang srin lag gnyis brkyang*/ mthe bong gnyis rna ba ltar byas la/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i gzebs las nges grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas// sangs rgyas zhing du bgrod par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tu raṃ ga a shwa rat+na pū dzi te hūm̐/ lag pa g.yon pa go cha 'dzin pa ltar byas lag pa g.yas pa mchog sbyin ltar byas la/ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas// nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas gyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khaḍ+ga rat+na pū dze te hūm̐/ zhes bya bas rin chen sna bdun dbul lo// yang 'dod yon lnga yang dbul te/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dze ta hūm̐/

phyogs dus kun nas zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan yid 'ong ldan// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shab+da kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dze te hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas tsan+dan sbrul snying dang*// a kar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed dri// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gan+dhe kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems rtas byed ro mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ra sa kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te hūm̐/ phyogs dus kun nas 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta spar+ṣe kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te hūm̐/ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dbyangs snyan pas bstod par bya ste/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /ces pa nas/ 'jig rten pa kun bstod par bya'o// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ de'i steng du'ang byed par 'dod pas/ snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings// zhes pa nas/ phyag 'tshal don yod grub pa la'o// zhes pa'i bar dang*/ yang spros pa la dga' na/ chos kyi 'khor lo skor mdzad pa// khams gsum pa yi 'gro kun gyi// ngan song thams cad sbyong mdzad pa// shākya seng ger phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin las// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// rang gi de nyid bstod mdzad pa'i// rdo rje gtsug tor phyag 'tshal lo// mnyam pa'i de nyid bsgom pa yis// khams gsum la gnas thams cad la// dbang bskur rab tu stsol mdzad pa'i// rin chen gtsug tor phyag 'tshal lo// so sor kun rtog rang bzhin can// chos kyi bdud rtsi'i char pa 'bebs// sems can dbugs 'byin mdzad pa po// pad+ma gtsug tor phyag 'tshal lo// sems can sdug bsngal bskyab pa'i phyir// bya ba rjes grub rang bzhin can// phrin las sna tshogs mdzad pa po// sna tshogs gtsug tor phyag 'tshal lo// khams gsum 'od kyis gsal mdzad nas// sems can kun gyi 'phags pa yis// bden pa mthong ba mdzad pa po// gtsug tor gzi brjid phyag 'tshal lo// yid bzhin nor bu rgyal mtshan bsnams// sbyin pas sems can thams cad kyi// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// gtsug tor rgyal mtshan phyag 'tshal lo// nyon mongs nye ba'i nye nyon mongs// gcod cing bdud bzhi'i stobs bcom pas// sems can byang chub thob mdzad pa'i// gtsug tor rnon po la phyag 'tshal// khams gsum 'gro ba thams cad kyis// gdugs dkar gyis ni rab brgyan pa'i// chos kyi rgyal po thob mdzad pa// gtsug tor gdugs dkar phyag 'tshal lo// sgeg mo phreng ba de bzhin glu// gar la lha mo bzhi po dang*// spos dang mar me me tog ma// dri yi lha mor phyag 'tshal lo// dad sogs ngo bo las byung ba// sgo yi dbus na gang bzhugs pa'i// lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril// sgo srung rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgo ba bzhi yi logs dag na// khyams la sogs par bzhugs mdzad cing*// rab dga' la sogs gnas mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems dpar phyag 'tshal 'dud// tshangs dang drags po'i zla ba sogs// phyogs bzhi'i 'jig rten skyong ba dang*// me dang srin po rlung lha dang*// 'byung po'i bdag por phyag 'tshal lo// nye bar mkho ba'i 'od zer las lag tu blang ba'i cho ga'i phreng ba'o// spros pa la dga' na ji ltar shes pas bstod par bya'o// rdzogs so//

//da ni gzhan don tshe 'das rjes su gzung ba'i don du/ bdun tshigs bsdus pa'i cho ga cung zad lag tu blang bar 'dod na de brjod par bya'o// de la don lnga ste/ gnas khang phyag dar la sogs pa byas te/ bla re dang*/ rten dgram pa dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma bsham pa dang*/ bum pa bca' ba dang*/ sdig pa sbyang ba'i rten dgod pa dang*/ bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du song nas phyir ldog pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni phyag dar byas te bla re bres nas/ bris sku dang lugs ma la sogs pa ji rigs pas mdzes par bya'o// gnyis pa ni mchod pa la yang mchod yon dang*/ me tog dang*/ bdug spos dang*/ mar me dang*/ dri dang*/ lha bshos dang*/ rol mo dang*/ gzhan yang ji ltar 'byor pa bsham mo// gtor ma yang ci 'byor pa yin mod kyi/ gsum mam bzhi las mi nyung bar bsham mo// gsum pa bum pa mdzes pa dri ma med pa/ mgul chings ras sngon pos dkri/ kha rgyan dang*/ nang du sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ rin po che lnga/ snying po lnga/ dri lnga bcug pa bsham mo// bzhi pa sdig pa sbyang ba'i rten ni/ lho phyogs su khru gang pa la pad+ma dkar po'i steng du 'khor lo sngon po bya/ gong ras la sogs pa mdzes tshon gyis maṇ+ḍal bris la/ de'i steng du ro'am/ rus pa'am/ gzugs sam/ gos sam rus pa las byas pa'i sāts+tsha'am/ ming byang gzhag par bya'o// de nas phyi ma red la sogs pa'i dus su gong du bstan pa ltar bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs par byas la/ de nas rten bskyed/ dgug gzhug byas te/ de la bzhi/ bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ rten bskyed pa dang*/ rten dgug pa dang*/ sdig pa dral ba'o// dang po ni 'di la kha cig bgegs 'brel zhes zer nas/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes bgegs kyis tshags byas pa de dang 'brel bar byed pa yin zer ba de ni min te/ bgegs kyi rnam shes gang na gnas mi shes pa'i phyir ro// 'o na ci'i phyir zhe na/ spyir bgegs ni gsum ste/

dri za 'chi ka ma'i yid la nye bar rgyug pa zhes bya ba dang*/ 'chi ka ma'i drung du bsnyen te tshe 'das pa'i gzugs bzung nas gson po rnams la gnod pa byed pa yod pas/ gson po rnams la phan gdags pa'i phyir/ tshar gcad pa'i phyir dang*/ gnyis pa ni lhan cig skyes pa'i 'dre zhes bya ba stobs skye ste/ lhan cig skyes pa'i lha zhes bya ba stobs chung bas/ tshe 'das de'i gzugs bzung nas gnas pa'i 'dre des shin tu 'tshe ste/ gson po dag la gnod pas/ gson po dang lhan cig skyes pa'i lha gnyis ka la phan gdags pa'i phyir/ 'dre de tshar bcad do// de gnyis ni 'chi bar 'gyur ba lung bstan pa'i mdo las bshad do// gsum pa ni/ tshe 'das pa nyid la bar dor skye ba blang kyang rung ste/ las kyi dbang gis bgegs gnod par srid pas/ de la yang phan gdags pa'i phyir/ drag po'i sbyin sreg gi bar gyis bya ba ste/ sbyong rgyud tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas bshad pa/ de nas de yi sdig 'joms lus// bgegs dang dral te ci bde bar// mtho ris 'jig rten mi yi nang*// khams gsum par ni ci bder spyod// ces pas so// de nas dgos pa gsum yod pas tshar bcad do// de'i cho ga ni sngon la byas kyang btub/ sdig pa dral nas byas kyang btub ste/ dang po zhi bas sbyang ba la gtor ma lan gsum sbyin pas sbyang*/ de nas zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba/ chang bu dang ting lo mar me sbyin zhing khro bo'i sngags bzlas te sbyang*/ de nas gu gul gyi dud pa dang*/ yungs kar gyis brab cing khro bo'i bstod pa dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ dbyangs med kyang rung ste/ khro bo'i sngags mang po bzlas shing drag pos sbyang ba yun ring du bya'o// bgegs sbyang ba'o// de nas rten ming byang la sogs pa de/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes pas stong par sbyang*/ tshe 'das kyi ming gi yi ge dang po'am/

nṛ las tshe 'das der bskyed/ de la yi dam gyi lha yod na de bskyed do// de nas dgug pa ni/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ bdag gi snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od dang*/ tshe 'das kyi snying ga'i hūm̐ ngam/ nṛ las 'od 'phros te/ khams gsum nas rnam shes bkug par bsam zhing bden pa brjod par bya'o// //sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi khro bo rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ gzungs sngags kyi khro mo rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi brlabs kyis/ tshe 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba khams gsum skye gnas bzhi/ gang na gnas kyang skad cig la 'dir mchis par gyur cig oṃ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥzhes brjod/ yang*/ oṃ sho dha ni sho ha ni sarba pā paṃ a pā na ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba'am/ srid pa bar ma'am/ 'gro ba rigs drug gang du skyes kyang*/ gang na gnas pa nas bkug la rten la bstim par bya'o// de nas bzhi pa sdig pa dral ba ni/ rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis mnyam la mtha' ma bzhi rtse sprad pa mnye zhing*/ oṃ sarba bita sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sarba bita tra tha/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi bi s+pho ṭa ya sarba a pā ya/ ban+dha ni pra mok+ṣa ya sarba a pa ya ga te bh+yaḥsarba satwa sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra sa ma ya tra tha/ zhes bya bas sdig pa sbyangs la/ rdo rje bsdams pa snying gar bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra ban+dha tra tha/ zhes pas sdig pa dral nas/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis spyi bo la sogs par gtug par bsams la/ oṃ sarba bita badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭhā dzñā na sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes bya bas rnam par shes pa a dkar po dri ma med par bsams la byin gyis brlab bo// de nas phyir bzlog gis sdig pa sbyang bar bya ste/

bye ma'am yungs kar gyis rten la brab cing*/ rtsa ba'i rig pa ci nus pa bzlas pa'i rjes la/ shāka thub nas 'byung ba'i brdeg pa'i sngags brjod cing brab ste/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bhasmi ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bruṃ bi nā sha ya ā wa ra ṇā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ druṃ bi sho dha ya ā wa ra ṇā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la/ dha ka dha ka ha na ha na ā wa ra ṇā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sruṃ sa ra sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra sarba ā wa ra ṇā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ ha ra ha ra sarba ā wa ra ṇā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa sarba ā wa ra ṇā ṇi bi s+pho ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sarba ā wa ra ṇā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarba ā wa ra ṇā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba ā wa ra ṇā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tun hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ga te he tun hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba ti ra ya ka ga te he tun hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti/ sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ gzhan yang rig sngags mthu dang gzi brjid chen po gzhan yang bzlas shing rten la brab cing*/ de nas khrus byas te/ bzlas pa bya ba'i bum pa'i chus lugs ma ras gris la sogs pa la me long bstan la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bkrus la bum par blug go /de nas bum pa thogs la/ nub gong ma rnams la ni me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba la bkru/

nub tha ma la ni ming byang la sogs pa'i rten dngos su bkru zhing*/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ dbyangs med kyang rung ste/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o// zhes bya ba dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes bzlas shing bkru'o// de nas de bzhin du tshigs su bcad pa re re'i rjes su sngags re bzlas te bkru zhing*/ 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu// khrims 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// tshul khrims dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis sku khrus gsol// 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu// khong khro'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// bzod pa dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis sku khrus gsol// 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu// le lo'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// brtson 'grus dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis sku khrus gsol// 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu// rnam g.yeng dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// bsam gtan dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis sku khrus gsol// 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu// shes 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// shes rab dri yis legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis sku khrus gsol// chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// gang la nyes pa mi mngal zhing*// khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud// dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas// dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad pa// rgya chen yon tan drug dang ldan// khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'// dri ma rnam drug dag pa yi// yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du// dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// zhes bya ba'i tshigs bcad re dang sngags re spel la bkru'o// bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa'ang ci shes pa brjod cing bkru ste/

logs shig tu brjod par bya'o// yang nyon mongs pa'i dug dang nyon mongs pa las skyes pa'i 'byung ba'i dug kyang sngags dang bcas pas bkru ste/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug yin te// sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug yin te// bcom ldan dam chos dug mi mnga'// dam chos bden pas dug bcom mo// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug yin te// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dug mi mnga'// dge 'dun bden pas dug bcom mo// sa 'di dug gi pha yin te// sa 'di dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum sa yi nang du song*// chu 'di dug gi pha yin te// chu 'di dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum chu yi nang du song*// me 'di dug gi pha yin te// me 'di dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum me yi nang du song*// rlung 'di dug gi pha yin te// rlung 'di dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum rlung gi nang du song*// zhes pas kyang bkrus la/ de nas bu la sogs pa'i lag tu mtshan byang 'dzin du bcug la/ yid kyi tshe 'das pa des phyag byed cing*/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad rnams ngag tu bzlas pas skyabs 'gro byed par bsam zhing*/ bdag gis dbyangs dang bcas pas brjod pa/ gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba skyob pa'i zhes pa nas/ 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// zhes pa'i bar/ sems thag pa nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing*/ nye ba'i sras brgyad la gsol ba gdab par bya'o// de nas sems bskyed pa gtso bor gyur ba'i rgyun bshags bya ste/ rjes zlos byed par bsam zhing*/

dbang med bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa dang*// zhes pa nas/ khyad 'phags gnas la'ang bdag nyid gnas par bgyi// zhes pa'i bar brjod par bya'o// da ni dbang bskur ba brjod par bya ste/ de yang rgyud las/ mos pa brtan dang bcas nas dam bcas nas/ sarba bita kyis ji ltar dbang bskur te/ zhes 'byung bas na/ de'ang 'di ltar bya ste/ spyi bor rdo rje 'dzin pas/ rtsa rig gi rjes la/ oṃ sarba bita sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ oṃ sarba bita phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bid aḥ oṃ sarba bita tra tha/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ/ oṃ sarba bita swa/ oṃ sarba bid aḥ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ oṃ sarba bita tra thā/ oṃ sha/ oṃ bha/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis dbang bskur te/ sarba bid kyis ji ltar dbang bskur te// bum pa la sogs ji snyed mang thogs nas// bcu po rnams kyi dbang bcu ci dgar bskur// de nas lag tu rdo rje dril bu sbyin// 'khor lo la sogs rin chen bdun thogs la// dbang phyug 'khor los sgyur ba thob pa dang*// sdig pa gzhom phyir dbang ni bskur bar bya// zhes 'byung bas bum pa dngos su smos pa yin la/ de'i rjes la sogs kyis bsdus pa dbang bcu ste/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i rigs lnga'i cod paṇa dang*/ rin po che'i cod paṇa dang*/ dar gyi cod paṇa dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ming dang*/ phrin las dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ bdag po dang*/ gzungs dang*/ gsang ba'i dbang gi bar bcu'o// yang na bum pa thogs te/ dar dang rin po che'i cod paṇa gnyis gcig tu byas te bcu'o// thabs dang shes rab ni rdo rje dril bu sbyin no// de nas rin po che sna bdun so sor phye na dbang bcu dgu bskur bar bya'o// de la dbang bcu dgu rgyud ji lta ba bzhin bsdus te dbang bskur ba dang*/ rgyas par dbang bskur ba gnyis so// dang po ni/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ sngags dang phyag rgyas dbang bskur te/

dang po bum pa'i dbang ni/ dngos su'am ting nge 'dzin gyis dbang bskur zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ rat+na ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ oṃ pad+ma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ de nas gong du smos pa'i phyag rgya bcing ngo*// rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan bcing zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ de nas phreng ba 'dogs pa ltar byas la/ rin po che'i phreng ba bcing bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ rat+na mā la a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐ trām̐ trām̐ trām̐ trām̐/ dar gyi cod paṇa 'ching ba'i tshul du bya zhing*/ bcing bar bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra pa ṭā laṃ ba a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya lag tu gtad nas byin par bsam zhing*/ oṃ bud+dha mu drā a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mu drā a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na mu drā a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ oṃ pad+ma mu drā a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma mu drā a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ rigs lnga'i ming 'dogs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ rat+na nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ oṃ pad+ma nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ sna tshogs rdo rje byin par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra karma a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ chos kyi 'khor lo byin par bsams la/ dkyil 'khor thams cad bsgrub nus pa dang*/ sems can la sprul pa dang*/ bshad pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nus par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ bh+rūm̐/ zhes brjod do// rigs thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje slob dpon byed nus par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha tsakra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ oṃ oṃ/

oṃ rat+na tsakra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐ trām̐ trām̐/ oṃ pad+ma tsakra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ oṃ karma tsakra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ.aḥ.aḥ zhes brjod do// dbang de thams cad kyang dran pa dang shes rab kyis mi brjed par gyis shig ces bsam pa dang*/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya dang*/ spyan dang*/ mā ma kī dang*/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang*/ gos dkar mo dang*/ sgrol ma rnams dang mi 'bral bar gyis shig ces kyang brjod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra dhā ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha dhā ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ rat+na dhā ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ oṃ pad+ma dhā ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma dhā ra ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ sngags kyi dbang rnams dam tshig ma thob pa la gsang bar gdams shing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta bud+dha gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ oṃ pad+ma gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ zhes brjod do// de nas dril bu byin la thabs dang shes rab stong pa dang snying rje chen po dang mi 'bral bar gyis shig ces brjod cing bsams la/ oṃ pra dzño pa ya sa ma yo ga a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ aḥ zhes brjod do// de nas shog bu las byas pa'i gzugs lag tu gtad pa'am ma gtad kyang rung ste/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i rin po che sna bdun de'i lag tu byin par bsams la/ phyag rgya dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ oṃ tsakra rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ ma ni rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ wa ti rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ ma hā ta rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ hasti rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ tu raṃ ga a shwa rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ oṃ khaḍ+ga rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes brjod cing dbang bcu dgu po bskur bar bya'o// dbang bcu dgu po de dag spros pa la dga' na rgyas par byas te/

dbang rdzas dang tshigs bcad dang bcas pas dbang bskur bar bya ste logs su shes par bya'o// de nas dbang bskur ba'i rjes la tshe 'das de yi dam gyi lhar bsams la mchod pa ci 'byor pa dang*/ me tog gi char dbab pa la sogs pa bya'o// gong gi mchod pa'i skabs der gos lham gtad pa zhes bya ba'i lag len byed pa yod pas de byed na/ tshe 'das lhar bsams la de la 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pas chas gos dang zas dang gtor ma la sogs pa dbul lo// yang yul kha cig na nub tha ma la byang bu bsreg pa'i cho ga la mos pa yod pas de byed na byang bu lag tu bzung la/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu// phung po lnga yi bud shing la// rgyal ba lnga yi me sbar ro// 'byung ba lnga yi bud shing la// lha mo lnga yi me sbar ro// dbang po drug gi bud shing la// byang chub sems dpa'i me sbar ro// yul rnams drug gi bud shing la// lha mo drug gi me sbar ro// lus ngag yid gsum bud shing la// rgyal ba'i sku gsum me sbar ro// sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan du// 'gro ba'i don du 'gyur bar shog /ces brjod la byang bu bsregs la btang ngo*// lam sbyang ba dang bstan pa ni/ nub gong ma rnams mchod pa'i rjes la byed la/ nub tha ma la ni byang bu bsregs pa'i rjes la byed do// de ni thams cad kyis me tog gi char dbab cing*/ 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o// dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du// dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba// dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis// rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa// tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam// mthong ba'i lam dang bsgom pa'i lam// bla na med pa'i khyad par lam// byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam/ rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la// brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs nas// 'phags pa'i lam der bgrod par shog /oṃ rat+ne rat+ne ma hā rat+ne rat+na saṃ bha wa/ rat+na ki rat+ne/

rat+na mā la bi shud+dhe/ sho dha ya sarba pā paṃ tra tha/ pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa// srid pa'i pad+ma las byung ba'i// bde ba can du skye bar shog /oṃ pad+me pad+me pad+ma saṃ bha we/ su kha wa tī gats+tshan+tu swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog dor ro// de nas tshe 'das bde ba can du skyes par bsam zhing*/ bde ba can du byang chub sems dpa' sngar skyes pa'i rnying pa rnams kyis de la mchod par bsam zhing*/ des kyang sangs rgyas 'od dpag med 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod nas/ der skye ba'i rgyu brtags pas slob dpon gyi mthu yin par shes te/ rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dir 'ongs nas/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod pa byed cing ched du brjod par bsam zhing*/ e ma ho sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas// e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs// gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs// byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag /ces brjod de mchod par bsam/ bdag gis kyang slar de la mchod de/ bde ba can du song bar bsam zhing*/ mchod pa lnga tsam gyis mchod la/ me tog gtor te/ de nas gtor ma dang mdo sngon du song nas/ bzang po spyod pa la sogs pa'i smon lam dang*/ gzhan yang cho ga lhag chad la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad la bshags pa'i bsams pas 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas// legs byas 'di la nyes pa gang*// gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pas// de ni mgon pos bzod par mdzod// gtso bo nus pa ma mchis pas// ma 'byor ma rnyed ma 'tshal ba// 'dir ni bgyi ba gang bgyis pa// de dag thams cad bzod par gsol// gang yang bdag cag rtsod pa'i dus// snyigs ma'i sems can du gyur pas gzhung gzhan du yo byad ma 'tshogs pa dang*/ ma 'byor pa mchis pa de dag thams cad bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis bzod pa dam par mdzad du gsol/ gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i sems can du gyur pas/

ting nge 'dzin la dbang ma thob ste/ bying ba dang*/ rgod pa dang*/ 'dod chags la sogs pa nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ cho ga nyams pas lhag chad du gyur pa dang*/ 'gal 'khrul du gyur pa la sogs pa nyes pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa de dag thams cad bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis bzod pa chen po mdzad du gsol/ bdag cag gis tshul bzhin du dkon mchog la mchod pa dang*/ 'byung po la gtor ma byin pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang sdig pa sbyong ba la sogs pa gang byas pa smos/ che ge mo zhes bya bas thog drangs pa'i sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa dang yang dag par ldan par gyur cig bde ba nyid dang yid bde ba des mi'i mchog rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig de ma thob kyi bar du yang*/ rnam par smin pa la mi re ba'i sbyin pa gtong bar gyur cig srid par skye ba la 'dun pa dang bral ba'i tshul khrims srung bar gyur cig sems can thams cad la zhe 'gres pa med pa'i bzod pa sgom par gyur cig dge ba'i chos thams cad yongs su sdud pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom par gyur cig gzugs med pa'i khams rnam par bsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug par gyur cig thabs snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don zab mo rtogs shing khong du chud par gyur cig de ltar gyur nas kyang sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig de ma thob kyi bar du mtho ris lha dang mi'i lus skyon med pa thob par gyur cig theg pa chen po ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang mi 'bral zhing rtag tu mnyes par byed par gyur cig

theg pa chen po zab pa dang rgya che ba ston pa'i chos dang mi 'bral zhing rtag tu spyod par gyur cig don dam dang kun rdzob kyi bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig lam bsgrub pa'i bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba rgya chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa byed nus pa dang ldan zhing don byed par gyur cig ces smon lam gdab par bya'o// nye bar mkho ba'i 'od zer las/ bdun tshigs kyi cho ga'o// ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyong ba ni/ kun rig nas 'byung bas de bshad par bya'o// de la don brgyad de/ thab khung bya ba dang*/ rgyan dgram pa dang*/ bsreg rdzas bsham pa dang*/ bud shing brtsig pa dang*/ bdag gi rnal 'byor dang*/ ro chas su gzhug pa dang*/ me sbar la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa dang*/ mjug gi bya ba'o// dang po ni/ khru gang pa yi tshad du ni// cho ga bzhin du khung brkos la// rdo rje mtha' ma bskor ba yi// 'khor lo dbus su bri bar bya// rigs lnga yi ni phyag mtshan rnams// ji bzhin pa yi phyogs su bri// de bzhin sems can rnams dang ni// 'jig rten gtso la sogs pa bri// zhes pa'i don ni 'di yin te/ phyi dro'i dus su gnas der dri zhim po'i chu dang*/ ba'i rnam lngas legs par byugs la/ ro nar mor bsregs nas khru bzhi par brko/ tsog pur bsregs na khru gang pa la shong bas/ grub na der lha tshang pa'i mtshan ma dgod de/ lte bar rdo rje phyogs bzhir/ 'khor lo/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs rdo rje bri'o/ de'i phyi rol du 'jig rten pa'i mtshan ma'am/ ming ngam/ brda'am/ thig le bri bar bya'o// ma grub na ma bris kyang nyes pa med do// de nas gnyis pa rgyan dgram par bya ste/ bya dang bum pa gang ba dang*/ gtor mas snod rnams bkang ba dang*/ brgyad snyed tsam du bzhag par bya// yang na bcu drug snyed du bzhag

/bza' ba dang ni bca' ba bshos// me tog phreng ba de bzhin te// bla re rgyal mtshan dar la sogs// gdugs mchog rnams kyis de bzhin brgyan// zhes bya ba yin te/ me tog la sogs pa ci 'byor pa dang*/ bla re la sogs pa bsham/ gtor ma ni cha gsum dang*/ gzhi bdag la gcig rigs drug la gcig yi dwags la gcig ste drug cis kyang bsham/ de nas kyang ci 'byor pa bsham mo// gsum pa bsreg rdzas bsham pa dang*/ bzhi pa bud shing brtsigs pa dang*/ lnga pa bdag gis rnal 'byor rnams ni/ lha yi rnal 'byor rab gnas la// ga pur gur gum la sogs pas// mar dang 'o ma til bsgos la// yungs kar dri chus legs bkang ste// 'bras chan yos dang la du dang*// sbrang rtsi ka ra dang ldan pas// brgya phrag du mar yongs bzlas la// yam shing la yang de bzhin du// rang gi sngags kyis btab pa'i shing*// khung bu'i nang du gzhug par bya// zhes 'byung ba'i don ni/ gong du smos pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams ci 'byor pas legs par sta gon bya'o// de nas bud shing la'ang rtsa ba'i rig pa bzlas shing*/ dri zhim po'i chus gtor khung bu legs par brtsigs la/ sgyed po'ang gzugs so// de nas ro'i drung du mchod pa ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa bshams la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor las kha tshar ba sngon du song yang rung la ma song yang rung ste/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i rnal 'byor byas la/ bzlas pa ci rigs pa byas te/ ro'i bya ba la 'jug par bya'o// drug pa ro chas su gzhug pa ni/ ro la sngags kyis btab nas kyang*// chu mchog gis ni bkrus nas su// bzlas pa'i dri yis byug par bya// gos dang rgyan gyis klubs nas kyang*// sngags kyis btab pa'i bdug pas bdug /me tog phreng la sogs pas mchod// gtsug phud dpung pa de bzhin du// sngags bris nas ni gdags par bya// snying ga lkog ma kha phyogs su// sarba bita kyi byin gyis brlabs// dpral ba mdzod spu rna ba gnyis// mgo bo gtsug phud dpung pa gnyis// sna dang rked pa pus mo bol// long bu sna yi rtse mo dang*// mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba'i gnas// dbang po rnams kyi gnas su ni// de ltar gzhan du yi ge sngags// mchog tu dge ba rnams bzhag go

/de nas ngan song sbyong ba'i phyir// stan dang bcas te thab dbus su// bzhag pa nyid du bya ba yin// de nas sngags 'chang sngags kyis ni// btab pa'i gos kyis g.yogs par bya// zhes bshad pa'i don 'di yin te/ bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa dang*/ gtor mas bgegs zhi bas sbyang*/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang*/ drag pos bgegs nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i don du sbyang ba ni/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi sngags ci rigs pa bzlas pas bgegs bsal lo// bum pa la rtsa ba'i rig pa bzlas pa'i chus bkru bar bya'o// rtsa rig bzlas pa'i dris nye bar byug par bya'o// rtsa rig bzlas te stod g.yogs dang*/ smad g.yogs ci rigs pa'i rgyan gyis klubs te mdzes par bya'o// gu gul la sogs pa'i dud pas bdug cing khro bo gang yin pa'i sngags bzlas par byas nas/ ro de nyid lha yin snyam du bsams nas ci 'byor pa'i mchod pas mchod de/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis snying ga dang*/ lkog ma dang*/ dpral ba dang*/ spyi gtsug dang*/ kha rnams su gtug cing*/ oṃ sarba bid badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭhā dzñā na sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes bya bas byin gyis brlabs la/ nyin mo shog bu la bris pa'i yi ge rnams gnas bco brgyad du gdags par bya ba ni/ dpral ba'i mdzod spur oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pa paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shud+dhe bi shod+dhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi shud+dhe swā hā/ zhes pa'o// de bzhin du rna ba g.yas pa la/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne sarba a pā ya sarba satwa bh+yaḥhūm̐/ rna ba g.yon pa la/ oṃ sarba a pā ya bi sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ mgo bo'i gtsug phud la/ oṃ tra tha/ dpung pa gnyis la hūm̐ gnyis/ sna gong la/ oṃ sarba bita sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ rked par oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ pus mo g.yas pa la/ oṃ sarba bita phaṭa/ g.yon pa la/ oṃ sarba bid aḥ bol gong g.yas pa la/ oṃ sarba bita tra tha/ g.yon pa la/ oṃ sarba bid oṃ/

long bu g.yas pa la/ oṃ sarba bita swa/ g.yon pa la/ oṃ sarba bid aḥ sna rtser/ oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ mig g.yas su/ oṃ sarba bita tra tha/ g.yon du/ oṃ sha/ gsang ba'i gnas su/ oṃ bha/ snying gar rtsa ba'i rig pa ste/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti ba ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ shodha ni shodha ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi shodha ni/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ sarba karmā ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes bya ba gdags par bya ste/ kun rig nas 'byung ba'i sngags de dag bris te/ btags na yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa de nyid nas bshad do// de tsam ma grub na gzhung nas/ gtsug pud dpung pa de bzhin du// sngags bris nas ni gdags par bya// zhes 'byung bas/ sngags rnams rdzogs pa tshar gsum bris la mgo bo dang*/ dpung pa gnyis kyi phyogs su btags la/ gnas bco brgyad po rnams su/ de ltar gzhan du yi ge sngags// mchog tu dge ba rnams su bzhag /ces pa/ bco brgyad por sngags bris nas lhan pa bzhin bsams kyang 'gal ba med do// zhes mtshan rnying pa'i bshad pa nas 'byung ba ste/ de ni legs par rtogs so// de nas ras khru gang ba'i gdan dang bcas te/ rol mo dang bgegs bskrad pa dang bcas pas thab kyi dbus su bcug la/ yang rtsa ba'i rig pa zlos bzhin du/ ci rigs pa'i gos kyis g.yogs par bya'o// bdun pa me sbar la/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha spyan drangs la mchod pa ni/ de yan chad phyi'i dkyil 'khor ma bris na/ da gzod phan chad phyi'i dkyil 'khor bri/ rgyan dgram bsreg rdzas sogs dgos pa rnams nye bar sta gon byas la/ de nas byin za dge ba rab sbar la// me lce stong gis dkrigs shing 'bar ba'i lus// zla dkar kun+da'i bzhin la zhi ba'i lus// mtha' yas pa yi gzugs kyis me bkug la// ar+gha dbul ba brtags nas de bzhin du// blo mchog ldan pa'i mdun du gzugs sogs bzhag

/ces pa dang*/ de nas tshigs bcad gcig gis rjes la/ de nas byin za la ni brtag bya ba// bsreg byas bkang ste thar bar bya ba'i phyir// zhes pa'i don ni 'di yin te/ me sbar te thab dang yo byad thams cad la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags bzlas shing*/ ku sha'i chun pos dri'i chu gtor la bgegs bsang*/ mchod pa la 'jug par bya'o// rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i sngags pas/ tshigs bcad ci shes pa dbyangs dang bcas pa dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye ma hā te dzaḥ sarba karmā pra sā dha ka kā ru ṇ+ya kṛ twā satwā r+thaṃ/ a smin san+ni hi to bha wa/ zhes bya bas me'i phyogs nas/ me lha dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ pad+ma dang ra skyes dkar po'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ g.yas rin po che dang dbyug pa/ g.yon pad+ma dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa spyan drangs te thab tu bzhugs su gsol la/ mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pas mchod la/ bsreg rdzas rnams bdud rtsir bsam ste thams cad bsreg pa'am/ so sor byas kyang btub ste/ oṃ ag+na ye sarba pā paṃ da ha na shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bya bas/ sbyin sreg lan ci rigs pa byas la bstod pa bya'o// de nas me ltar 'bar ba nas 'byung ba bzhin khro bo me ltar 'bar ba spyan drangs la/ lan gsum dbul bar bya'o// de nas dkon mchog gsum la lan gsum dbul bar bya ste/ de yang dbul ba ni/ ji skad gsungs pa'i yon tan 'dod pa yis// de bzhin gshegs pa de ltar spyan drangs la// ar+gha la sogs brtags te de bzhin du// bde gshegs gsungs pa'i mchod pa gang yin bya// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ de nas bsreg byas bkang ste rim bzhin gyis// rgyal la sogs pa brgya rtsa brgyad du brtag /de nas sbyong ba'i sngags kyis rgyal po la// bsreg par bya ba nyi shu rtsa gcig brtag /de nas spyan drangs yo byad lan gsum dang*// ar+gha la sogs pad+ma dkar zhal mchod// ces bya ba'i don ni 'di yin te/

yi dam gyi lha rnams mchod de/ bstod pas bstod la/ bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams ro'i sha khrag rus pa dang bcas pa rnams bdud rtsir bsam ste/ rtsa ba'i rig pa'i mjug tu oṃ sarba pā paṃ shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes btags pas/ gtso bo la brgya rtsa brgyad dbul bar bya'o// de nas gtso bo'i shar phyogs na bzhugs pa'i sbyong pa'i rgyal po la rang gi sngags kyis nyer gcig dbul bar bya'o// de nas 'khor gzhan rnams la yang rang rang gi sngags kyis lan gsum gsum dbul la mchod de bstod par bya'o// de nas yang*/ phyag na rdo rje pad+ma zhags pa bsnams// 'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gzugs// zhabs kyi pad+mas sdig mnan cing*// rgyan rnams kun gyis rab rdzogs pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dbu rgyan mtho// bsams sam yang na bris kyang rung*// de yi snying pos de bzhin du// brgya phrag stong ngam yang na ni// bye ba'i tshad du sbyin sreg bya// ci ste mtshan ma la sogs 'byung*// de bzhin sdig can rgyud shes bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don 'di yin te/ de ltar dkyil 'khor mchod nas ma gshegs par phyag na rdo rje 'jig rten gsum las rgyal ba'i gzugs spyan drangs la/ kun rig gi spyan sngar bzhugs su gsol la/ ci 'byor gyis mchod la/ sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ bsreg rdzas rnams dang ro'i sha khrag rus pa rnams bdud rtsir bsams la dbul te/ oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha ā na lā rka ma hā badz+ra kro dha dra ba dra ba/ bi dra ba bi dra ba/ sarba a pā ya/ nā sha ya nā sha ya/ ha ra ha ra prā ṇā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ che ge mo'i sdig pa thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pas lan brgya rtsa brgyad nas bye ba'i bar du ci rigs par phul la sbyin sreg bya'o// des ni me'i dbus su sdig pa dag pa la sogs pa'i rtags rnams zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang mthun par ston par 'gyur ro// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang*/
